metaDescription: American Shorthair vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so American Shorthair boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan American Shorthair social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader American Shorthair exposure.
Weight range 8-12 lb (3.5-5.5 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat weekly.) belong in the same American Shorthair household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your American Shorthair is also monitored for obesity, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed American Shorthair appointments.
After the American Shorthair puppy/kitten series, keep adult FVRCP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed American Shorthair boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the kitten and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every American Shorthair row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra FVRCP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed American Shorthair item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next American Shorthair kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new American Shorthair due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the American Shorthair core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my American Shorthair misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read American Shorthair health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the American Shorthair adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (hcm) risk, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
